description: A new digest of a base image is the point of this repository's pipeline: the runtime base is Chainguard's
nginx, which is rebuilt upstream as fixes land, and its free tier publishes only `latest`, so the digest is
the pin. Merging the bump runs the build workflow on main, which scans the image and publishes the next
patch version. The `gate/build` status is what lets the merge wait for that scan: the bot's token cannot
No soak time. A base digest is a fix more often than a risk, and a bad one is stopped by the scan.
